catalog.title: The eval environment refused a tool call: the coordinator worktree guard (subagent trials) or the headless permission posture (both arms)
Guessed `t.state` on a `renderComponent()` handle (it has `t.states`, `t.next()`, `t.waitForState()`; no `state`)
`t.html()` read before the first render (returns `''`; await `t.ready()` / `t.next()` first)
Isolation trap: parent `DOM.select` on elements rendered inside a child (SYG104)
